Since the two labeled pulse transfer blocks are in a cascade path and there is no feedback or branching shown, combine them by multiplying their transfer functions. Therefore G(z)=G1(z)G2(z).

method.method_draft: From the diagram, let the z-domain input to the first transfer block be U(z). The first block labeled G1(z) produces an intermediate signal X1(z)=G1(z)U(z). That intermediate signal is the input to the second block labeled G2(z), whose output is Y(z)=G2(z)X1(z). Substituting gives Y(z)=G2(z)G1(z)U(z), so the overall pulse transfer function is G(Z)=Y(z)/U(z)=G1(Z)G2(Z).
